task_a: Allow Context.default_map to use dashed option names, such as api-key, as aliases for Click's internal underscored parameter names, such as api_key.
task_b: Allow Context.default_map values to override automatically derived environment variable values during option resolution.
merge_result: Patch A and Patch B apply cleanly to the same base commit with git apply; no textual conflict is reported.
failure_summary: Patch A broadens default_map lookup to treat dashed keys as aliases. Patch B gives default_map higher precedence than auto envvars. Together, a dashed default_map alias unexpectedly overrides APP_API_KEY, changing the composed command output from from-env to from-map.
notes: Seed instance used to validate the AgentConflictBench packaging and oracle format. This is a controlled configuration-precedence conflict in Click option resolution.
